company.name: Invertix
company.location: Munich, Bavaria, Germany; San Francisco, California, United States
company.funding: €1.7M / approximately $2M pre-seed led by Vireo Ventures, with Italian Founders Fund and strategic angels

evaluation.summary: Invertix builds autonomous AI workers for renewable-energy companies that monitor plants, draft reports, reconcile revenue, track contracts, and triage alarms. The published Forward Deployed Engineer opening strongly matches Paarth's production-agent, backend, observability, data-pipeline, customer deployment, and distributed-systems experience. The company is a very small, recently funded team with Munich headquarters and a stated San Francisco presence. The main constraint is unverified remote eligibility from India.
strengths: Published Forward Deployed Engineer opening plus explicit willingness to hear from candidates outside predefined roles
Direct alignment with production AI agents, workflow automation, evaluation, tracing, and reliability
Times Astro provides relevant experience operating conversational AI, comparing models, analyzing feedback, and tracing production behavior at scale
Renderperk proves ownership of distributed backend systems, queues, storage, payments, deployment, metrics, logs, and incident response
Energy operations require ingestion of noisy telemetry, alert triage, reporting, auditability, and human approval
The forward-deployed role values broad product and customer problem-solving rather than narrow model research
Tiny team and fresh pre-seed funding make direct founder outreach unusually valuable
Company lists both Munich and San Francisco, preserving a credible future SF connection
gaps: No direct renewable-energy, SCADA, inverter-telemetry, project-finance, or European energy-compliance experience
No confirmed experience embedded with enterprise customers under a Forward Deployed Engineer title
Remote work from India, employment structure, and visa or relocation support are not published
The role may require substantial on-site work in Munich or at European customer sites
German or Italian language expectations are unknown
unknowns: Whether the Forward Deployed Engineer role is still accepting applications through the Tally form
Whether a remote internship-to-full-time start from India is possible
Expected Munich or customer-site travel and working-hour overlap
Compensation, equity, employment type, and relocation or visa support
Exact production stack, agent framework, model providers, evaluation system, and data infrastructure
Current revenue, paying-customer count, runway, and how the stated 350+ MW is distributed across customers
Security model for agents operating inside customer data and critical-infrastructure workflows
Human approval, rollback, audit, and failure-recovery controls for autonomous actions
evaluation.outreach_angle: Lead with production reliability for AI agents, not generic climate enthusiasm. Show how Paarth has operated agentic and distributed systems with tracing, evaluations, queues, retries, observability, payments, and large-scale analytics. Connect this to Invertix's need to ingest imperfect telemetry, suppress false alerts, explain decisions, preserve audit trails, and safely deploy workflows into customer environments. Ask Kaan about a remote internship-to-full-time or paid trial from India and offer a concrete reliability artifact.
evaluation.proposed_artifact: Build a small renewable-operations agent reliability harness using synthetic inverter telemetry, weather context, contracts, and alarms. The agent should normalize data, rank alerts by estimated revenue impact, draft an operator report, and open a maintenance recommendation only after policy checks. Add traces, evaluation cases for missing telemetry and false alarms, idempotent ticket creation, human approval, audit logs, retry handling, and rollback. Present latency, false-positive rate, tool-call accuracy, and recovery behavior.

pipeline.next_action: Build or outline the renewable-operations agent reliability harness, apply through the published Tally form, then send a personalized LinkedIn message to CTO Kaan Durmaz. Use Joseph Perrotta, Nicolas Gutierrez de Esteban, and Pietro Valente as differentiated alternatives.
pipeline.notes: The public hiring post lists Forward Deployed Engineer, Product Manager, Head of Sales, and open-ended candidates. Remote-from-India eligibility is not stated. Do not mark outreach or application as sent until Paarth explicitly confirms it.
